description: This file implements the LBFGS optimizer class for PyTorch, including functions for cubic interpolation and Wolfe line search, and the optimizer's step logic.

classes.name: LBFGS
classes.description: Implements the L-BFGS optimization algorithm for PyTorch models.

methods.name: _cubic_interpolate
methods.description: Performs cubic interpolation between two points, used in line search.

methods.name: _strong_wolfe
methods.description: Performs Wolfe line search to find suitable step size.

methods.name: LBFGS
methods.description: Constructor for the LBFGS optimizer, setting hyperparameters and initial state.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Performs a single optimization step using L-BFGS algorithm with optional line search.
